classification.difficultyReason: Determine rectangular and triangular base areas before applying the pyramid volume formula.

content.prompt: Find the volumes of these pyramids.

spec.description: Rectangular-based pyramid with visible silhouette and front ridge, dashed hidden edges, highlighted perpendicular height, right-angle marker and curved height pointer. Decorative face shading omitted.
spec.mathematics: Rectangular base 7 m by 6 m; perpendicular pyramid height 5.5 m.
spec.answerVisibility: Dimensions only; volume is hidden in student questions.

spec.description: Tall triangular-based pyramid. Separate pointers identify the pyramid height and the base-triangle altitude; the altitude meets the front base edge at a right-angle marker. Decorative face shading omitted.
spec.mathematics: Triangular base has edge 13 m and perpendicular altitude 15 m; pyramid perpendicular height is 18 m.
spec.answerVisibility: Dimensions only; base area and volume are answer content.
